$comment: The Node runtime shipped inside the desktop app.
Pinned by version AND SHA-256. Verifying against nodejs.org's own
SHASUMS256.txt would only prove the download matched what that server
served us today, which is not the property we want when the result gets
code-signed and shipped to other people. These digests are committed, so a
changed artifact fails the build instead of quietly entering a release.
To bump: change the version, re-fetch that file, replace every digest, and
re-run the packaged --self-test on each target you advertise.
